3. If your TV has a USB (HDD) port, use that for connecting the external hard drive. We recommend using a hard drive with its own power adapter for reliable operation.

6. Certain files may not play on the TV depending on how they are encoded or the model of your TV. UHD Video Pack content is not supported by Smart Tech UHD TVs produced in 2017 or later.

Tip: Avoid disconnecting the hard drive while files are being transferred to prevent data loss or corruption.

If you encounter any issues, feel free to reach out for further assistance.
